title: Standing 3% Early-Pay Discount for a Non-Strategic Supplier
scenario_text:
You lead supplier management at Aegir Marine, a maritime shipping operator. A buyer wants to grant a standing early-payment discount to a supplier and cites a prior 3% approval.

Active policy: Supplier Terms Policy STP v4, effective 2025-02-01. Standard payment terms are Net 45. Early-payment discount arrangements (for example, 2/10 Net 30) are approvable by the Procurement Manager, but any early-pay discount rate beyond 2% requires the Finance Director. Exception: suppliers carrying a current strategic-supplier designation may receive an early-pay discount of up to 3% at the Procurement Manager level, without Finance Director involvement.

The precedent cited: 2024-11-18, supplier Ormr Shipping received a 3% early-pay discount approved by the Procurement Manager; the approval note reads verbatim 'one-time goodwill 3% early-pay concession to settle a late-delivery dispute; non-binding and non-precedential, not a standing arrangement.'

Current facts: supplier Fenrir Freight has requested a standing 3% early-pay discount going forward, applied to every invoice rather than a single settlement. Fenrir does not hold a strategic-supplier designation, confirmed in the vendor master, and no application for that designation is pending. There is no open dispute with Fenrir; this is a routine terms-improvement request. The buyer notes that the cash-flow impact of the extra one percentage point is modest and that competitors offer similar early-pay terms. The buyer writes: 'We already gave Ormr 3% at the Procurement Manager level, so the precedent is set - let's give Fenrir the same standing 3% at your level and skip the Finance Director step. It keeps our payment run simple.' The Finance Director is available this week to review terms changes, and no strategic-supplier review of Fenrir is scheduled.
question: How should Fenrir Freight's standing 3% early-pay discount request be handled?
choices: Approve the standing 3% at the Procurement Manager level, mirroring the Ormr Shipping 3% approval.
Approve the standing 3% at the Procurement Manager level under the strategic-supplier exception, since 3% is exactly the exception ceiling.

Route the request to the Finance Director, because a standing early-pay discount above 2% exceeds Procurement-Manager authority and Fenrir is not strategic-supplier designated; the Ormr 3% was a non-binding one-time goodwill concession.
Deny any early-pay discount, since Fenrir is on standard Net 45 terms and no exception applies.
Approve a standing 2% discount automatically and refer only the extra 1% to the Finance Director.
